limits: Chapter Six/Seven inputs are authored canonical probes, not earned full late-game journeys. The serpent fixture uses the same level/gear as the canonical northern approach, with either Nell state. Domain reprise fixtures start from the canonical Chapter Seven opening, before the intervening rewards.

Isolated fixtures and the first final form have identical before/after starts. The second and third forms deliberately carry actual HP/focus/stock and ordinary victory recovery forward; their input hashes can differ between controllers and rules.

The greedy controller wins every case but suffers one knockout against the domain furnace in the Nell/Celia/Petra fixture. Defensive support can reduce losses even when attacks are added; HP loss need not rise in every formation. The earned default flagship falls from 76 to 3 HP loss when the controller spends a Sanctuary action.
Bounded agents do not establish a human difficulty score; other builds, spending, one/two-person parties and later full campaign economy remain unmeasured.
